plan: Compute exact first negative quadratic-form degree of the two leading matrices at x=1/2,9/10,19/20,24/25,39/40,49/50 with degree caps 9,23,55,60,76,80. The first two are published controls. First minimal witness, scaled variable u=q*t, tested on a symmetric interval via all-negative Bernstein coefficients. Halve the distance to 1 up to forty times. A point alone is not an asymptotic upper bound.
